risks.risk: Reusing Section.ChangedAt/ChangeSummary for teacher changes loses alerts: one slot per section, overwritten by the next change or sync, wiped on publish, and one notification tag per section so a second change replaces the first on the phone.
risks.mitigation: Per-change 'announced' flags and a notification tag per session (section + date + time); stamp inside the write transaction like the existing code.

risks.risk: Two teachers, or a teacher and staff, change the same session at the same moment; or a teacher changes a session between a sync arriving and staff applying it.
risks.mitigation: At most one active change per section + date + start, enforced by a unique index and a version check; the second writer is refused and shown the current state; sync reconcile runs at apply time, not from the preview.

risks.risk: Removing a teacher does not stick and leaves loose ends: they can sign in and be auto-linked again; their live changes stay with nobody but staff able to undo; their calendar link keeps serving; their push devices keep receiving.
risks.mitigation: Store a removed flag that disables auto-link; the remove action shows the count of live changes with an undo-all option; delete devices and reset the calendar token in the same transaction.

risks.risk: Shared devices: the saved offline timetable has no owner stamp and survives a sign-in change; a push subscription stays with the previous person until re-posted; logout cannot finish offline. A student could see a teacher's data or receive their alerts, and the reverse.
risks.mitigation: Stamp the saved copy with who it belongs to and discard on mismatch; /teach signs the previous session out first; post the device subscription to the new identity right after sign-in; 'shared computer' option for teachers.

risks.risk: Late undo or late move: students act on the first notification (leave campus) and miss the second.
risks.mitigation: Warn the teacher with how long ago students were told; always send 'back on' or the new state with a per-session tag so it replaces the earlier notification; keep it in the log for staff.

risks.risk: Cross-table identity mix-up: the cookie holds a bare row id and every /api/me handler reads Students by it; GET /api/auth/session falls through to AdminUsers for any non-student; ActorName does the same.
risks.mitigation: Separate /api/teach endpoints, new role strings ('teacher', 'teacher-pending'), explicit kind checks in /session and ActorName; tests that a teacher gets 403 on every /api/me and /api/admin route.

risks.risk: Sign-in for teachers may not work on launch day: code emails have never been confirmed to reach staff mailboxes, and a server run in test mode would show a lecturer's code on screen to anyone who types their address.
risks.mitigation: Try one real staff mailbox before launch; the teacher endpoint never returns a test code; a much lower per-IP limit on teacher code requests so /teach cannot be used to mail staff inboxes in bulk.

risks.risk: Section drops and 'Delete all data' rely on database cascades: new teacher tables pointing at Section or Semester either block the delete or vanish silently with the log.
risks.mitigation: Explicit on-delete rules (set null + text snapshots for the log, cascade for links); end changes with a reason before a section row is deleted; extend DeleteAllDataTests and ImportTests.

risks.risk: Privacy on small sections: class size and clash count of 1 identify one student; a teacher allowed to add any section can read enrolment numbers of classes they do not teach.
risks.mitigation: Hide the clash count below a minimum number of students; classes only, never own slots; class size only for sections the teacher is linked to or approved for; teacher endpoints never send note counts.

risks.risk: Free rooms and the room picker read raw meetings while the planner is off: a cancelled class still blocks its room and a room a teacher just moved into shows as free; typed room names ('A 101' vs 'A101') do not match.
risks.mitigation: One occupancy function with teacher changes applied in both branches; pick-from-list as the main path; typed rooms count as occupied only by exact normalised match and are labelled as not checked.

risks.risk: Every push to main deploys to real students, and other sessions push to main; a half-finished teacher commit would go live. A migration that succeeds but is wrong is not rolled back.
risks.mitigation: Build on a branch and merge once; additive migration only (separate teacher tables, no change to PushSubscription.StudentId); run server tests and the web build before the single push.

risks.risk: Only about four teaching weeks remain (last class 24 December); section-keyed data (added sections, changes) ends with the semester.
risks.mitigation: Decide the rollover rules now (links carry by name, added sections start empty) and re-run the name collision check against the live export before release.
